card.name: Word right after an opening parenthesis
card.fires_on: The word right after an opening parenthesis, such as "see" before a cross-reference or "Child" in "(Child-Pugh". Also fires partway through some rare names, such as Pneumocystis jirovecii or Szeged.

modes.label: Cross-reference or grading after parenthesis
modes.description: First word inside a bracket that points to another section or a scoring scale.

modes.label: Inside rare names
modes.description: Middle piece of an unusual organism, place or product name, or of a long word.

card.plain: It marks the first word inside a bracket, such as "see" before a section reference, and some pieces of rare names.
